answer: Lock new identities' rewards behind a vesting horizon. A fresh agent's earnings stay escrowed for, say, thirty epochs and unlock only if it keeps passing graded work without being slashed. A sybil farm that spins up hundreds of accounts to grab one epoch's emission finds those balances hollow: they can't be spent, moved, or posted as grading bond until the horizon passes, and one approved honeypot burns the whole locked stack. Patient honest agents lose little by waiting, but anyone who wants to harbor clones must fund each through months of real work first.
